15: class ModelConfig:
16:     vocab_size: int = 264
17:     width: int = 32
18:     layers: int = 1

20:     max_length: int = 128
21:     norm: str = "layer"

31: class Block(nn.Module):
32:     def __init__(self, config):
33:         super().__init__()
34:         norm = nn.LayerNorm if config.norm == "layer" else RMSNorm
35:         self.norm1, self.norm2 = norm(config.width), norm(config.width)
36:         self.attention = CausalAttention(config.width, config.heads, config.kv_heads, config.backend, config.rotary)
37:         self.ffn = (
38:             MoEFFN(config.width, config.experts, config.top_k)
39:             if config.experts
40:             else DenseFFN(config.width, activation=config.activation)
41:         )
42: 
43:     def forward(self, x, valid=None, positions=None, segments=None, cache=None):
44:         attended, new_cache = self.attention(self.norm1(x), valid, positions, segments, cache)
45:         x = x + attended
46:         h = self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
47:         auxiliary = x.new_zeros(())
48:         if isinstance(h, tuple):
49:             h, auxiliary, _ = h
50:         return x + h, new_cache, auxiliary

53: class TinyLM(nn.Module):
54:     def __init__(self, config=None):
55:         super().__init__()
56:         self.config = config or ModelConfig()
57:         c = self.config
58:         if c.norm not in ("layer", "rms") or c.layers < 1 or c.max_length < 1:
59:             raise ValueError("無效的 norm/layers/max_length 設定")
60:         self.embedding = nn.Embedding(c.vocab_size, c.width)
61:         self.position = None if c.rotary else nn.Embedding(c.max_length, c.width)
62:         self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(c) for _ in range(c.layers)])
63:         self.final_norm = nn.LayerNorm(c.width) if c.norm == "layer" else RMSNorm(c.width)
64:         self.output = nn.Linear(c.width, c.vocab_size, bias=False)
65:         if c.tied:
66:             self.output.weight = self.embedding.weight
67: 
68:     def forward(self, ids=None, *, embeddings=None, valid=None, positions=None, segments=None, cache=None):
69:         if (ids is None) == (embeddings is None):
70:             raise ValueError("必須恰好提供 ids 或 embeddings 其中之一")
71:         x = self.embedding(ids) if embeddings is None else embeddings
72:         b, t, _ = x.shape
73:         offset = 0 if cache is None else cache[0][0].shape[2]
74:         if offset + t > self.config.max_length:
75:             raise ValueError("序列超過 max_length；增加配置或明確截斷，不能默默重用位置")
76:         if positions is None:
77:             positions = torch.arange(offset, offset + t, device=x.device)
78:         if self.position is not None:
79:             x = x + self.position(positions)
80:         caches, auxiliary = [], x.new_zeros(())
81:         for i, block in enumerate(self.blocks):
82:             x, state, aux = block(x, valid, positions, segments, None if cache is None else cache[i])
83:             caches.append(state)
84:             auxiliary = auxiliary + aux
85:         logits = self.output(self.final_norm(x))
86:         return {"logits": logits, "cache": caches, "auxiliary": auxiliary}
87: 
88:     def description(self):
89:         return {"config": asdict(self.config), "parameters": sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters())}

31: class CausalAttention(nn.Module):
32:     def __init__(self, width, heads=1, kv_heads=None, backend="manual", rotary=False):
33:         super().__init__()
34:         kv_heads = kv_heads or heads
35:         if width % heads or heads % kv_heads:
36:             raise ValueError("width 必須能被 heads 整除，heads 必須能被 kv_heads 整除")
37:         self.heads, self.kv_heads, self.head_dim = heads, kv_heads, width // heads
38:         if rotary and self.head_dim % 2:
39:             raise ValueError("RoPE 的 head_dim 必須是偶數")
40:         if backend not in ("manual", "sdpa"):
41:             raise ValueError("attention backend 必須是 manual 或 sdpa")
42:         self.backend, self.rotary = backend, rotary
43:         self.q = nn.Linear(width, width, bias=False)
44:         self.k = nn.Linear(width, kv_heads * self.head_dim, bias=False)
45:         self.v = nn.Linear(width, kv_heads * self.head_dim, bias=False)
46:         self.out = nn.Linear(width, width, bias=False)
47: 
48:     def forward(self, x, valid=None, positions=None, segments=None, cache=None):
49:         from tiny_perceptron.modern import rope
50: 
51:         b, t, d = x.shape
52:         q = self.q(x).view(b, t, self.heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
53:         k = self.k(x).view(b, t, self.kv_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
54:         v = self.v(x).view(b, t, self.kv_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
55:         offset = 0 if cache is None else cache[0].shape[2]
56:         pos = torch.arange(offset, offset + t, device=x.device) if positions is None else positions
57:         if self.rotary:
58:             q, k = rope(q, pos), rope(k, pos)
59:         if cache is not None:
60:             if valid is not None or segments is not None:
61:                 raise ValueError("最小 cache 路線只接受無 padding、無 packing 的單長度 batch")
62:             k, v = torch.cat((cache[0], k), 2), torch.cat((cache[1], v), 2)
63:         new_cache = (k, v)  # 儲存未擴張的 KV heads，GQA 才能縮小 cache。
64:         keys = torch.arange(k.shape[2], device=x.device)
65:         queries = torch.arange(offset, offset + t, device=x.device)
66:         allowed = attention_mask(queries, keys, valid, segments)
67:         repeat = self.heads // self.kv_heads
68:         k, v = k.repeat_interleave(repeat, dim=1), v.repeat_interleave(repeat, dim=1)
69:         if self.backend == "manual":
70:             out, _ = manual_attention(q, k, v, allowed)
71:         else:
72:             out = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, attn_mask=allowed, dropout_p=0.0)
73:         out = out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(b, t, d)
74:         return self.out(out), new_cache
